notes.title: Patch Update for the Steam version of Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium
notes.content:
We have released an update that addresses the following issues for the Steam version of Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium:
•	Issue where the base game, “SONSON” was unplayable.
•	Issue where the purchased DLC were inaccessible.

tags.bug: •	Issue where the base game, “SONSON” was unplayable.
